{{Top|leg}}
The '''"Fable of the Crystalline Kåhlyt"''' was a popular parable on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]].<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

The story goes that a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] found a [[kåhlyt]] that lays [[rubat]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] in the form of [[Egg/Legends|eggs]]. The farmer began selling the crystals and became rich, but his wife was impatient and rather than wait every [[Moon/Legends|moon]] cycle for the crystals, she cut the kåhlyt open to get them all. What she found instead were just the intestines of the creature.<ref name="MedStar II" />

The moral of the story was that one's greed and impatience could ruin a good thing.<ref name="MedStar II" />

==Behind the scenes==
A virtually identical story in real-life is the "[[Wikipedia:The Goose that Laid the Golden Eggs|The Goose that Laid the Golden Eggs]]."
